parameters: The gods came one by one... Bonding with the realm...
At their zenith, the Pantheon was 13 deities strong.
But alas, nothing is meant to last...
One of the twin deities of the stage, Lyric, betrayed
the pantheon, and attempted a coup.
They successfully devoured the head goddess, Aeris,
and absorbed her power!
It took the entire pantheon's strength to bind Lyric
for enough time in order to rescue Aeris by extracting
her soul.
With Lyric's defeat, the gods sought to punish the
treacherous jester. After much deliberation, Prisma
convinced the others to spare Lyric from death.
Instead... Their \c[1]Riftheart \c[0]was torn from their
soul, and as a result, it was shattered. The fallen
deity was then cast to Swallouti's deserts to be
forgotten...
The jester seethed with anger and bitter resentment,
swearing that one day they would return and devour them
all...
However... Lyric was cunning, and they wormed their way
into the seat of power of a struggling kingdom named
\c[5]Ruhath\c[0], and begun to amass an army.
After 200 years, Lyric would begin their assault on
the mortal realm, conquering kingdom after kingdom
with no contest!
Now the realm of Swallouti is in danger, and the gods
are nowhere to be found!
If this war continues its current trajectory...
There may not be a home to return to...
\c[1] Ingrid:
And that is why we have moved here! This tower will
keep us safe from those that wish to take us both
away!

\c[0]Um... Mistress? Why can't the gods come

\c[0]I do not know, my child... But one day, they will
